name: windows-build-descendants
argv: $all=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process; $ids=@(18068); for($i=0;$i -lt 6;$i++){ $children=@($all | Where-Object {$_.ParentProcessId -in $ids -and $_.ProcessId -notin $ids}); $ids+=@($children | ForEach-Object {$_.ProcessId}) }; $all | Where-Object {$_.ProcessId -in $ids} | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,CommandLine | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3
